Vijay Bajiya Murder Case: What is the mystery behind the 7007 Gang and a seven-year-old revenge plot?
On November 11, 2026, Jaipur history-sheeter Vijay Bajiya (25) was brutally murdered in broad daylight-style violence on a public street. The attackers allegedly rammed his Toyota Fortuner with a camper vehicle, chased him and attacked him with axes.
